intro: AI agent systems engineer and technical founder. I have spent the past year on agentic systems and harness engineering, starting while I was finishing high school, where I was also wrestling team captain for two years. For most of that stretch I worked 13 to 14 hours a day on it, around school, my job and wrestling. I work across several harnesses instead of just one: OpenCode and DeepSeek Harness, Claude Desktop and Claude Code, Gemini Antigravity, and ChatGPT Codex. My flagship single-binary Rust desktop and web applications (Linux, macOS, and Windows .exe with chromeless desktop launch) are OpenRO v1.2.0 (Studio Copilot 3-pane Roblox Studio AI IDE with 7-gate Ship & Monetization Readiness Autopilot, Agent/Plan/Ask unified Luau diffs, 12 FPS isolated Studio capture, OpenRoCompanion.lua Studio plugin, all 13 official MCP tools, Market Taste Craft Radar, and Rojo .zip export at 4,487 req/s), OpenBell v0.9.0 (Institutional Quant Terminal for Kalshi Trade API v2 with 1-click Full Quant Edge Audit 5-stage Go/No-Go funnel, causal lookahead-canary tests, fail-closed Hard Risk Rails disarmed on every boot, Emergency Kill Switch, Out-of-Sample Strategy Tournament, PAV Isotonic Calibration, and $500/Day Capital Scaling Engine), and Fleet v0.10.0 (Codex/Linear parallel coding-agent workbench with Goal-to-DAG planner, 1-click Batch Merge with git merge-tree preflight, enriched Auto-Heal, instant keyboard triage, PR Preview, Worktree Inspector, and Daily Dispatch Budget guardrails at 6,256 req/s), alongside Ergon v0.11.0 (Claude-Desktop employee agent desk with context-aware 1-click workflow auto-detection, side-by-side .history/ diff preview & restore, gzip/ETag serving at 6,427 req/s, inline approval cards, cadence scheduler, tamper-evident Field-Book audit bundles, 3-company switcher, and 12 workflows).
